findings.limit: The direct accessor reference scan is incomplete (adjacent ADRP/ADD and B/BL only) and returned nohits. This does not establish no producer exists; constant metadata references, inlining and owner-injected config remain possible. No radius derived from height/2.

findings.conclusion: The original sign-out confirmation prepares an optional user String before selecting generic or personalized localized title; current generic title is a valid source branch.
findings.limit: The source fields supplying optional String have not been positively named here; do not replace with the preview displayName/accountID, infer email fallback or copy a personal reference name. Generic and personalized localized forms are declared resources, not proof every screen should show a name.

findings.conclusion: Original sign-out confirmation has Log out and Cancel actions and a destructive confirmation role; confirmation callback reaches the busy-guarded owner operation.
findings.limit: Service task continuation, remember-login choice/default, full failure presenter and post-logout account cleanup are not recovered by this UI callback. Logged save_login_option_presented is not visible-choice evidence.

implementation_decision.reason: No new deterministic missing metric or confirmation action was found. Existing sign-out generic branch and busy contract already cover the proved front-end behavior. Replacing fixture dimensions or adding personalized/remember-account controls would invent configuration.
implementation_decision.safe_boundary: Keep source-named style slots explicit and keep current fixture geometry labeled. Keep generic signout title until an optional original identity/title provider is mapped; do not fabricate personalized title from accountID.
